Oneliner

Demonstrator for a constellation-as-a-service IoT constellation.
Description

Build a constellation for connecting sensors and other Internet of Things devices. A customer with their own IoT payload payloadsould then provide service to customers while the consortium handles the space operations. Funding will support two to three cubebesats the consortium hopes to launch to low Earth orbit at the end of 2020.
